title: Duplicate primitive lint
root_cause: New implementations can accidentally introduce parallel authority for an existing primitive.
source_requirement: Statically and conservatively flag duplicate primitive definitions unless an explicit exception exists.
implementation_steps: Emit deterministic findings; use no AI guessing.
evidence_required: Known duplicate, alias, exception, and ambiguity vectors.
rollback: Disable lint gate and retain authority registry; never auto-delete implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Known duplicate primitives fail without a narrow exception.
Ambiguity is reported, not guessed clean.
